jobs.description: Les meilleurs designers ne sont pas toujours ceux qui dessinent le mieux. Ce sont ceux qui posent les bonnes questions avant d’ouvrir Figma. Ceux qui défendent un choix avec des arguments utilisateurs et business, pas esthétiques. Chez Hubvisory, on veut une équipe Design qui pense comme ça, et on cherche la personne qui va la faire grandir. Ta mission. Tu as un double rôle. Tu interviens toi-même en mission chez un de nos clients grands comptes, où tu portes l’expertise Design au plus haut niveau. En parallèle, tu manages une équipe de 6 à 8 Product Designers : leur progression, leur staffing, la qualité de leurs missions. C’est parce que tu restes sur le terrain que ton management est crédible. Tes responsabilités clés Montrer la voie en mission : tu es toi-même en mission chez un client, sur des sujets à fort enjeu. Tu y démontres ce qu’on attend d’un designer Hubvisory, et tu transmets cette exigence à ton équipe. Faire grandir tes designers : suivi individuel, feedbacks réguliers, plans de progression. Tu les aides à passer d’exécutants UI à consultants qui cadrent des problèmes, mènent la recherche et pèsent sur les décisions produit. Piloter le staffing : tu travailles main dans la main avec l’équipe commerciale pour qualifier les besoins clients, positionner le bon profil sur la bonne mission et anticiper les fins de mission. Faire du Design augmenté par l’IA une réalité : tu intègres l’IA dans ta pratique et dans celle de ton équipe, de la synthèse de recherche au prototypage. Tu sais aussi concevoir des expériences où l’IA est au cœur du produit. Porter l’exigence Design chez Hubvisory : tu contribues à structurer nos pratiques (User Research, discovery, design systems) et tu participes au recrutement de tes futurs designers. Notre objectif : faire de toi un Manager reconnu, capable de construire une équipe Design qui fait la différence chez nos clients. La suite se dessine selon ton impact. jobs.description: A Place for Mom is building the future of senior care, and design is central to how families, caregivers, providers, and APFM teams navigate that experience. We are looking for a Staff Product Designer to own product design for Consumer Experience and help us turn emotionally complex care decisions into clear, trustworthy, high-quality product experiences. APFM is organizing around the two customers that define our marketplace: families navigating care decisions and providers delivering care. Evolving toward a more connected experience across the full care placement journey. This role is for someone who is curious about where product design is going, not only where it has been. We do not expect anyone to have ten years of experience with tools that are only beginning to emerge. We do expect you to be actively experimenting with AI tools, learning where they help, where they fail, and how they can create leverage without replacing judgment, craft, accessibility, ethics, or deep user understanding. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Marketing, Analytics, Operations, Sales, and business leaders to shape consumer journeys that help families understand their options, build confidence, and take the next best step in a high-stakes senior care decision. jobs.description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Your work will directly contribute to making early skin cancer detection accessible and user-friendly.
